title: Oscar D NDE 22393
content: I was given too much gas in the dentist’s office, died, and floated up above my body. I was about three feet above. I could look down with complete clarity at the dentist and see the top of his head, back of his head, looking into my mouth. Then, I floated down the hallway of the office, in the opposite direction, of where my body was being taken. They took my body to the recovery room, where they found me dead, not breathing with no heartbeat. The nurses and doctor worked on recovery, with my mom screaming with anxiety. I was in a state of curiosity. I was trying to comprehend what was happening, but only for a few minutes. I knew I had died and was glad it was over with. It was awful to die. To die was terrible, but as soon as I let go, I was left with peace. I decided to explore the area, went outside, came back in, and then met my real parents, who explained that my mom in life was a nice person, but not my real mom. I knew, without any doubt, what they were saying was completely true; because I could feel the intense love and affection they had for me. I could feel a direct link to them and they were both like guardian angels, advising me of my situation, and giving me advice on what to do. But, I did not take their advice, because I knew, that my mom on earth would suffer throughout her life without me, so I felt it necessary to save her from that fate and return, even if she was not my real mom. I felt the pain she would have to go thru, knowing I died would ruin her life and I felt I would be the one to suffer more. By returning to this life and giving up an opportunity to go to a better life, as my real parents had told me was available and waiting for me.

arrival.other_being_detail: Met 'my real parents' who were 'both like guardian angels,' advising him and giving advice.

environment.environment_other_detail: Dentist office interior (hallway, recovery room area) and outside the building ('went outside, came back in').

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with observations and movement through office/outside, then encounter with 'real parents' and decision to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Encountered 'my real parents' (not his earthly mother), described as 'both like guardian angels,' who said a better life was available and waiting.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I could look down with complete clarity at the dentist and see the top of his head, back of his head, looking into my mouth.” / “I knew I had died and was glad it was over with.” / “To die was terrible, but as soon as I let go, I was left with peace.”
